LESSON: TAQWA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Taqwa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Taqwa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What actions lead to piety?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
2. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief
3. appreciate the virtue of taqwa as a pre-condition for success in this life and the Hereafter

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: TAQWA
This lesson teaches Taqwa for Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the virtue of taqwa as a pre-condition for success in this life and the Hereafter
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Taqwa using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Taqwa above.
2. Explain Taqwa to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Taqwa.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Taqwa with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Taqwa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What actions lead to piety?
2. Why is taqwa important in the life of a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building
2. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief
3. appreciate the virtue of taqwa as a pre-condition for success in this life and the Hereafter

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
